name: Puzzling Pakenham Saturday 2025
information:
This is a series competition alongside [Puzzling Pakenham Sunday 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PuzzlingPakenhamSunday2025). You will be permitted to compete at **ONLY ONE** of these two competitions. If you register for both, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)
